CATEGORY: V.V. for requests or plans (Grammar)
definition: Use V.V. to make a request or express a tentative plan, not simply for any completed narrative action.

HER NOTES IN THIS CATEGORY (1 distinct):
6 | V.V. is used to make requests or plans

HER CORRECTIONS (8 of 8):
[shennong_samples#40/f4/p0/k0/e0] 他[跳跳了→跳了跳]  || her note: V.V. is used to make requests or plans
[mengmu_samples#26/f4/p0/k0-1/e2] 孟子老是想[玩玩→玩]  || her note: V.V. is used to make requests or plans
[shennong_samples#39/f4/p0/k0/e0] 但是他刚[尝尝→尝]的花  || her note: V.V. is used to make requests or plans
[mengmu_samples#26/f5/p0/k0/e0] 在家不是学习就是[玩玩→玩]  || her note: V.V. is used to make requests or plans
[mengmu_samples#26/f2/p2/k0/e1] 孟子从早到晚想[玩玩儿→玩儿]  || her note: V.V. is used to make requests or plans
[shennong_samples#50/f4/p1/k0/e0] 他跑遍[尝尝→尝了]各种各样的植物  || her note: V.V. is used to make requests or plans
[mengmu_samples#28/f1/p0/k1/e0] 孟轲老是[看看→去看]别的人
[mengmu_samples#50/f4/p0/k0/e0] 孟子的妈妈不是工作就是[-试一试]帮助她的儿子孟子

output.rule: Use V.V. to make a request or express a plan. Do not use V.V. simply to describe an action in a completed narrative; use the ordinary verb or the corrected completed form instead.
output.explanation_template: <wrong> → <correct>: This describes a completed/narrative action, not a request or plan, so do not use V.V.; use <correct> instead.

examples.explanation: 玩玩 → 玩: This is a habitual narrative action, not a request or plan, so do not use V.V.; use 玩 instead.
尝尝 → 尝: This describes the flower he had just tasted, not a request or plan, so do not use V.V.; use 尝 instead.
玩玩儿 → 玩儿: This is what he wanted to do from morning to night, not a request or plan, so do not use V.V.; use 玩儿 instead.
尝尝 → 尝了: This is a completed narrative action, not a request or plan, so do not use V.V.; use 尝了 instead.
跳跳了 → 跳了跳: For this completed action, use 跳了跳, not 跳跳了.

output.not_an_error: V.V. is appropriate when making a request or expressing a plan.
